/**
 * Load current user settings
 */
async function loadUserSettings() {
    // TODO: Fetch user settings from API
    const authToken = localStorage.getItem('authToken');
    if (!authToken) {
        //window.location.href = 'login.html';
        return;
    }

    try {
        // Fetch user data from the API
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/auth/me`, {
            method: 'GET',
            headers: {
                'Authorization': `Bearer ${authToken}`
            }
        });
    const userData = await response.json(); 

    populateSettingsForm(userData);
    } catch (error) {
        displaySettingsMessage('Error fetching user data:', 'error');
        localStorage.removeItem('authToken'); // Clear token on error
        //window.location.href = 'login.html'; // Redirect to login page
    }
}

/**
 * Populate settings form with user data
 * @param {object} userData - User data
 */
function populateSettingsForm(userData) {
    const previewImg = document.getElementById("profile-picture-preview");
    
    // Construct full path for profile picture
    if (userData.profile_picture) {
        const baseUrl = API_BASE_URL.replace('/api', ''); // Remove /api suffix
        previewImg.src = `${baseUrl}/uploads/${userData.profile_picture}`;
    } else {
        // Set a default placeholder or blank image
        previewImg.src = "assets/images/default_avatar.png"; //modified
    }
    
    document.getElementById("name").value = userData.name;
    document.getElementById("username").value = userData.username;
    document.getElementById("email").value = userData.email;
    document.getElementById("phone").value = userData.phone;
}

/**
 * Handle settings form submission
 * @param {Event} event - Form submit event
 */
async function handleSettingsSubmit(event) {
    event.preventDefault();

    const authToken = localStorage.getItem('authToken');
    const name = document.getElementById("name").value;
    const username = document.getElementById("username").value;
    const email = document.getElementById("email").value;
    const phone = document.getElementById("phone").value;

    const currentPassword = document.getElementById("current-password").value;
    const newPassword = document.getElementById("new-password").value;
    const confirmPassword = document.getElementById("confirm-password").value;

    const dataToUpdate = {
        name: name,
        username: username,
        email: email,
        phone: phone
    }

    try {
        const response = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/settings/`, {
            method: 'PUT',
            headers: {
                'Content-Type': 'application/json',
                'Authorization': `Bearer ${authToken}`
            },
            body: JSON.stringify(dataToUpdate),
            redirect: "manual"
        });

        if (!response.ok) {
            let errorData;
            const contentType = response.headers.get('Content-Type') || '';
            try {
                if (contentType.includes('application/json')) {
                    errorData = await response.json();
                } else {
                    errorData = await response.text();
                }
            } catch (parseError) {
                try {
                    errorData = await response.text();
                } catch (textError) {
                    errorData = 'Unable to read error response body';
                }
            }
            console.error("Settings update failed:", response.status, errorData);
            displaySettingsMessage('Error updating settings', 'error');
            return;
        }

        const res = await response.json();

        // Password change logic
        if (currentPassword || newPassword || confirmPassword) {
            if (!currentPassword || !newPassword || !confirmPassword) {
                displaySettingsMessage(
                    "Please fill all password fields to change password",
                    "error"
                );
                return;
            }

            if (newPassword !== confirmPassword) {
                displaySettingsMessage("New passwords do not match", "error");
                return;
            }

            const passwordResponse = await fetch(
                `${API_BASE_URL}/settings/password`,
                {
                    method: "PUT",
                    headers: {
                        "Content-Type": "application/json",
                        "Authorization": `Bearer ${authToken}`,
                    },
                    body: JSON.stringify({
                        current_password: currentPassword,
                        new_password: newPassword,
                        confirm_password: confirmPassword,
                    }),
                }
            );

            const passwordRes = await passwordResponse.json();

            if (!passwordResponse.ok) {
                displaySettingsMessage(passwordRes.detail || "Error changing password", "error");
                return;
            }

            displaySettingsMessage("Password changed successfully", "success");
        }

        displaySettingsMessage('Settings updated successfully', 'success');

    } catch (error) {
        displaySettingsMessage('Error updating settings', 'error');
    }

}

/**
 * Validate settings form
 * @returns {object} - Validation result with isValid and errors
 */
function validateSettingsForm() {

}

/**
 * Validate password change fields
 * @returns {object} - Validation result for password fields
 */
function validatePasswordChange() {

}

/**
 * Handle profile picture upload
 * @param {Event} event - File input change event
 */
async function handleProfilePictureUpload(event) {
    const file = event.target.files?.[0];

    if (!file) {
        displaySettingsMessage("Please select a file", "error");
        return;
    }

    // Validate file type
    const allowedTypes = ["image/png", "image/jpeg", "image/jpg", "image/gif"];
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
        displaySettingsMessage("Only PNG, JPG, JPEG, and GIF files are allowed", "error");
        event.target.value = ""; // Clear input
        return;
    }

    // Validate file size (5MB max)
    if (file.size > 5242880) {
        displaySettingsMessage("File too large. Maximum size is 5MB", "error");
        event.target.value = ""; // Clear input
        return;
    }

    // Show preview before upload
    previewProfilePicture(file);

    // Upload to server
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", file); // Backend expects "file" field name

    try {
        const token = localStorage.getItem("authToken");

        const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE_URL}/settings/profile-picture`, {
            method: "POST",
            headers: {
                Authorization: `Bearer ${token}`
            },
            body: formData
        });

        const data = await res.json();
        
        if (!res.ok) {
            throw new Error(data.detail || "Upload failed");
        }

        displaySettingsMessage("Profile picture updated successfully", "success");
        
        // Update preview with the uploaded filename
        // Note: /uploads maps directly to backend/uploads/profile_pictures
        const previewImg = document.getElementById("profile-picture-preview");
        if (previewImg && data.filename) {
            const baseUrl = API_BASE_URL.replace('/api', ''); // Remove /api suffix
            previewImg.src = `${baseUrl}/uploads/${data.filename}`;
        }

    } catch (err) {
        displaySettingsMessage(err.message || "Error uploading profile picture", "error");
        console.error("Upload error:", err);
    }
}

/**
 * Upload profile picture to server
 * @param {File} file - Image file to upload
 * @returns {Promise<string>} - Uploaded file path
 */
async function uploadProfilePicture(file) {
    // TODO: Upload file to server
}

/**
 * Preview selected profile picture
 * @param {File} file - Selected image file
 */
function previewProfilePicture(file) {
    const reader = new FileReader();
    const previewImg = document.getElementById("profile-picture-preview");

    reader.onload = function(e) {
        if (previewImg) {
            previewImg.src = e.target.result;
        }
    };

    reader.onerror = function() {
        displaySettingsMessage("Error reading file", "error");
    };

    reader.readAsDataURL(file);
}

/**
 * Display settings update message
 * @param {string} message - Message to display
 * @param {string} type - Message type (success/error)
 */
function displaySettingsMessage(message, type) {
    const messageElement = document.getElementById("settings-message");
    if (!messageElement) {
        console.warn('Settings message element not found');
        return;
    }
    messageElement.textContent = message;
    messageElement.className = `settings-message ${type}`;
    messageElement.style.display = 'block';
    // Auto-hide after 3 seconds
    setTimeout(() => {
        messageElement.style.display = 'none';
    }, 3000);
}

/**
 * Handle form reset
 * @param {Event} event - Reset event
 */
function handleFormReset(event) {
    // TODO: Reset form to original values
}

// Initialize on DOM load
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
    loadUserSettings();

    const form = document.getElementById("settings-form");

    // check for submits
    const saveBtn = document.getElementById("save-btn");

    const uploadBtn = document.getElementById("upload-btn");
    const profilePictureInput = document.getElementById("profile-picture");

    if (saveBtn) {
        saveBtn.addEventListener("click", handleSettingsSubmit);
    }

    // Upload button triggers file input click
    if (uploadBtn && profilePictureInput) {
        uploadBtn.addEventListener("click", () => {
            profilePictureInput.click();
        });
    }

    // File input change event handles upload
    if (profilePictureInput) {
        profilePictureInput.addEventListener("change", handleProfilePictureUpload);
    }
});
